newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Novartis unit, Isis in distribution pact.
newsitem.headline: Novartis unit, Isis in distribution pact.

text.p: Novartis AG said on Tuesday its Ciba Vision unit and Isis Pharmaceuticals of the U.S. reached an agreement which grants Ciba Vision exclusive worldwide marketing rights to an Isis drug for AIDS-related cytomegalovirus retinitis.
The drug, called Fomivirsen, is a novel antisense drug currently in Phase III clinical trials.
Antisense drugs work at the genetic level to interrupt the process by which disease-causing proteins are produced.
Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis is a late-stage opportunistic infection that can affect 25 to 40 percent of AIDS patients, Novartis said in a statement.
It said the agreement calls for Isis to receive $20 million in a pre-commercial fee and milestone payments through the regulatory approval process in the U.S. and in Europe.
Isis will manufacture and sell fomivirsen to Ciba Vision at a price that will allow Isis and Ciba Vision to share the commercial value of the product, Novartis also said.

It said Ciba Vision will hold the registrations once regulatory approvals are obtained and receive options to acquire exclusive license to market and distribute a second-generation antisense compound to treat right CMV retinitus which Isis currently has in pre-clinical development.
